violated_contract: Keyword arguments bound onto a LangChain chat model before with_structured_output must still reach the provider. RunnableBinding does not define with_structured_output, so the lookup forwards to the unbound model and the bound kwargs are silently dropped. On GPT-5.6 this drops prompt_cache_options, which is the difference between a readable cached prefix and a full-price uncached call.
canonical_prevention: Bind extra_body and prompt_cache_key after with_structured_output (prompt_cache.bind_explicit_cache / with_cache_write_opt_out). Guard with a test that asserts the invoked runnable's kwargs, not the arguments passed to get_llm.
